from sympy import isprime, primerange

def check_conditions(p, q, r):
    if not (p < q < r):
        return False
    if not (isprime(p) and isprime(q) and isprime(r)):
        return False
    
    s1 = p + q - r
    s2 = q + r - p
    s3 = r + p - q
    s4 = p + q + r
    
    if isprime(s1) and isprime(s2) and isprime(s3) and isprime(s4):
        return True
    return False

# Case 1: p + q = 800
# Since p < q, p < 400.
results_1 = []
for p in primerange(2, 400):
    q = 800 - p
    if isprime(q) and p < q:
        # We need to find r.
        # s1 = p + q - r = 800 - r
        # For s1 to be prime, r < 800 - 1 = 799.
        # Also r > q.
        # s2 = q + r - p = r + (q - p)
        # s3 = r + p - q = r - (q - p)
        # s4 = p + q + r = 800 + r
        # We can iterate r from q+1 up to 797.
        for r in primerange(q + 1, 800):
            if check_conditions(p, q, r):
                results_1.append(r)

# Case 2: p + r = 800
# p < q < r.
# Since p + r = 800, r < 800.
# Also p < 400.
results_2 = []
for p in primerange(2, 400):
    r = 800 - p
    if isprime(r):
        # q must be between p and r.
        for q in primerange(p + 1, r):
            if check_conditions(p, q, r):
                results_2.append(r)

# Case 3: q + r = 800
# Since q < r, q < 400.
# p < q.
results_3 = []
for q in primerange(2, 400):
    r = 800 - q
    if isprime(r) and q < r:
        # p must be between 2 and q.
        for p in primerange(2, q):
            if check_conditions(p, q, r):
                results_3.append(r)

all_results = results_1 + results_2 + results_3
print(f"Case 1 results (r): {results_1}")
print(f"Case 2 results (r): {results_2}")
print(f"Case 3 results (r): {results_3}")
print(f"All results (r): {all_results}")
if all_results:
    print(f"Max r: {max(all_results)}")
